counterfactual_text: The wooden block reaches the rough floor and continues across it at unchanged speed to the end of the visible corridor.
positive_text: The wooden block moves continuously down the ramp, reaches the rough floor, and then loses speed steadily until it remains at rest.
semantic_text: A wooden block slides down a ramp onto a rough floor, slows continuously, and comes to rest. Initial scene: A fixed side view of one wooden block resting near the upper end of a sloped ramp that leads directly onto a visibly rough, level floor. The entire ramp, transition edge, block, and a long open floor region are unobstructed and fully visible under neutral lighting. Required visible entities: one wooden block; one sloped ramp; one rough level floor. At the beginning: wooden block: intact and resting near the upper ramp end; ramp and rough floor: connected by one visible transition edge. Required layout: ramp descends directly onto the rough floor; a long visible floor corridor extends beyond the ramp; block, ramp, transition edge, and stopping area fit inside the frame. Required state changes: block position: upper ramp to floor; block speed: increasing on ramp to decreasing on rough floor; block motion state: moving to resting. These event variables are allowed to change: block position; block speed; block motion state. Preserve throughout: static side-view camera; ramp geometry; rough-floor texture and background; one wooden block; one ramp leading to one rough floor; the same block and fixed scene.
